CHAPTER.VERS: By David. Do not fret because of evildoers,neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass,and wither like the green herb. BET
Trust in the , and do good.Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
Also delight yourself in the ,and he will give you the desires of your heart. GIMEL
Commit your way to the .Trust also in him, and he will do this:
he will make your righteousness go forth as the light,and your justice as the noon day sun. DALET
Rest in the , and wait patiently for him.Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way,because of the man who makes wicked plots happen. HEY
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath.Do not fret, it leads only to evildoing.
For evildoers shall be cut off,but those who wait for the shall inherit the land. VAV
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more.Yes, though you look for his place, he isn't there.
But the humble shall inherit the land,and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace. ZAYIN
The wicked plots against the just,and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The Lord will laugh at him,for he sees that his day is coming. HET
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow,to cast down the poor and needy,to kill those who are upright in the way.
Their sword shall enter into their own heart.Their bows shall be broken. TET
Better is a little that the righteous has,than the abundance of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken,but the upholds the righteous. YOD
The knows the days of the perfect.Their inheritance shall be forever.
They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil.In the days of famine they shall be satisfied. KAPH
But the wicked shall perish.The enemies of the shall be like the beauty of the fields.They will vanish-vanish like smoke. LAMED
The wicked borrow, and do not pay back,but the righteous give generously.
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land.Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off. MEM
A man's goings are established by the .He delights in his way.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall,for the holds him up with his hand. NUN
I have been young, and now am old,yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken,nor his children begging for bread.
All day long he deals graciously, and lends.His seed is blessed. SAMEKH
Depart from evil, and do good.Live securely forever.
For the loves justice,and doesn't forsake his holy ones.They are preserved forever,but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
The righteous shall inherit the land,and live in it forever. PEY
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom.His tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart.None of his steps shall slide. TZADE
The wicked watches the righteous,and seeks to kill him.
The will not leave him in his hand,nor condemn him when he is judged. QOPH
Wait for the , and keep his way,and he will exalt you to inherit the land.When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it. RESH
I have seen the wicked in great power,spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not.Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found. SHIN
Mark the perfect man, and see the upright,for there is a future for the man of peace.
As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together.The future of the wicked shall be cut off. TAV
But the salvation of the righteous is from the .He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
The helps them, and rescues them.He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them,Because they have taken refuge in him.
